records.title: Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Intelligent IT Operations: An AOI System with Context-Aware Compression and Dynamic Task Scheduling
records.reason: AOI is a multi-agent framework for autonomous IT operations whose LLM context compression (72.4% smaller operational context) and dynamic scheduling serve incident-response task success; the systems techniques are embedded in an AIOps application.

records.title: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Agentic Search by Recycling Zero-Variance Queries During Training
records.reason: Recycles zero-variance GRPO rollout groups back into a mutable pool during RL training of LLM search agents; an RL training-efficiency method, not inference.

records.title: On the Invariants of Softmax Attention
records.reason: Defines the energy field of softmax attention and proves mechanism-level invariants (per-row zero-sum, head-dimension rank bound) plus key incoherence; theoretical/interpretability analysis without a deployable inference mechanism.

records.title: ActiFormer: Sign-Aware Linear Attention for Sensor-Based Human Activity Recognition
records.reason: ActiFormer is a sign-aware linear attention architecture tailored to sensor-based human activity recognition on resource-limited devices; a HAR task model, not LLM inference.

records.title: d-HNSW: A High-performance Vector Search Engine on Disaggregated Memory
records.reason: d-HNSW is an RDMA-based HNSW vector search engine co-designed for disaggregated memory pools; it is retrieval infrastructure used by LLM applications rather than LLM inference itself.

records.title: The Routing and Filtering Structure of Attention
records.reason: Decomposes the QK^T interaction matrix of 1776 heads into skew-symmetric routing and symmetric filtering parts and studies a diagnostic S-D parameterization; mechanistic analysis of attention, not an inference system.

records.title: MemScope: Evolving Agent Memory Architectures through Localized Code Repair
records.reason: MemScope evolves deployed agent memory architectures through evidence-grounded localized code repair by a patch agent; a self-improving agent framework, not inference execution.

records.title: CLIMP: Contrastive Language-Image Mamba Pretraining
records.reason: CLIMP replaces both CLIP encoders with Mamba, reporting 5x less memory and 1.8x fewer FLOPs at high resolution, but the contribution is a contrastive vision-language pretraining model for retrieval/robustness rather than an inference system.

records.title: Ternary Mamba: Grouped Quantization-Aware Training of W1.58A16 State Space Models
records.reason: Ternary Mamba applies grouped quantization-aware training with distillation from a frozen FP16 teacher to compress Mamba-2 1.3B by 3.61x (2,687 to 744 MB) for edge deployment of state-space models.

records.title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning
records.reason: Selective Regenerative Decoding routes each sampled trajectory to discard, keep, or regenerate only its degraded suffix, provably improving sample efficiency 1.28-1.36x over rejection sampling and matching Best-of-N with substantially fewer generated tokens.

records.title: MUSE: Parallel Multi-Scale Attention for Sequence to Sequence Learning
records.reason: MUSE is a 2019 parallel multi-scale attention architecture for sequence-to-sequence machine translation; a task architecture for MT, not an inference-system contribution.

records.title: PICASSO: Unleashing the Potential of GPU-centric Training for Wide-and-deep Recommender Systems
records.reason: PICASSO restructures GPU-centric training of wide-and-deep recommender systems to fix GPU underutilization from fragmented embedding operations; a training system for recommenders.

records.title: Pre-training Multi-task Contrastive Learning Models for Scientific Literature Understanding
records.reason: SciMult is a multi-task contrastive pretraining framework (with an MoE transformer variant) for scientific literature understanding tasks such as citation prediction; pretraining methodology.

records.title: Window Attention is Bugged: How not to Interpolate Position Embeddings
records.reason: Identifies that interpolating position embeddings under window attention is a bug in Hiera/ViTDet and fixes it with absolute window position embeddings for COCO detection; a vision-model correctness fix.

records.title: ∞-Video: A Training-Free Approach to Long Video Understanding via Continuous-Time Memory Consolidation
records.reason: Infinity-Video adds continuous-time long-term memory consolidation to video Q-formers so arbitrarily long videos can be processed training-free; the memory mechanism targets a video-understanding task rather than LLM serving.

records.title: Efficient Strong Scaling Through Burst Parallel Training
records.reason: DeepPool uses burst parallelism and GPU multiplexing to strong-scale DNN training at fixed global batch size; a training system.

records.title: TensorPrism: Rethinking Sparse High-Order Tensor Acceleration via Co-Occurrence Graph
records.reason: TensorPrism accelerates sparse high-order tensor computation via a co-occurrence graph across LLM, scientific-computing and recommender workloads; a general tensor accelerator framework, not specific to LLM inference.

records.title: MoDE: Effective Multi-task Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning with a Mixture of Dyadic Experts
records.reason: MoDE shares the LoRA down-projection across tasks with rank-one dyadic experts for multi-task parameter-efficient fine-tuning on SuperNatural Instructions; a fine-tuning method.

records.title: Modulated Diffusion: Accelerating Generative Modeling with Modulated Quantization
records.reason: Modulated Diffusion accelerates diffusion-model sampling with modulated quantization and error compensation, pushing activation PTQ from 8 to 3 bits; generative diffusion inference, not LLM inference.

records.title: On Zero-Initialized Attention: Optimal Prompt and Gating Factor Estimation
records.reason: Provides optimal-estimation theory for prompts and gating factors in zero-initialized attention (LLaMA-Adapter) and its connection to mixture-of-experts; fine-tuning theory.
